workers.name: Market Scout
workers.role: Reads OANDA practice pricing and identifies quote status.

workers.name: Spread Watcher
workers.role: Measures spreads, quote quality, and paper signal conditions.

workers.name: Risk Sentinel
workers.role: Verifies all execution locks remain closed.

workers.name: Paper Strategy Analyst
workers.role: Converts market metrics into paper-only strategy observations.

workers.name: Kernel Commentary Runner
workers.role: Routes paper-lab summaries to the local-only QSB Kernel speech layer.

workers.name: Ledger Clerk
workers.role: Writes paper signals and simulated P/L markers to the ledger.

workers.name: Equity Market Scout
workers.role: Reads US equities quotes and bars via the Floor 43 read-only gateway.

workers.name: Stock Spread Watcher
workers.role: Measures bid/ask spreads and market-status to gate paper signals.

workers.name: Equity Momentum Analyst
workers.role: Computes momentum windows and volatility from recent stock bars.

workers.name: Cross-Market Correlation Clerk
workers.role: Reads OANDA, Binance, and Stock registries and produces correlation pairs.

workers.name: Risk-On/Risk-Off Observer
workers.role: Aggregates cross-market biases into risk_on_watch / risk_off_watch labels.

workers.name: Stock Ledger Clerk
workers.role: Persists paper stock observations into the audit ledger (no orders, ever).
